query: Civiqs Trump net job approval adults 35-49 September 2026

results.content:
According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%. [...] Gender: Roughly two-thirds of women (70%) disapprove of Trump's performance. Men lean unfavorable toward Trump, with 60% disapproving and 35% approving.
